quarterly_data.signal: Xanadu began the next phase of its collaboration with Mitsubishi Chemical on quantum algorithms for EUV lithography resist materials: an industry-oriented workflow feeding parameters from Xanadu's quantum simulations into Mitsubishi's multi-scale blur models, producing a fault-tolerant-quantum-computing-ready software pipeline, supported by the National Research Council of Canada Industrial Research Assistance Program (NRC IRAP) and Japan's Strategic Innovation Promotion Program (SIP, led by AIST and G-QuAT). Xanadu has previously received more than $800,000 in NRC IRAP funding across several projects.
